'''Mohan Ramachandra Wani''' (1965 – 14 April 2024) was an Indian cell biologist, immunologist and a scientist at the [[National Centre for Cell Science]]. Known for his studies in the fields of bone and cartilage cell biology, osteoimmunology, and regenerative medicine, Wani was an elected fellow of the [[National Academy of Sciences, India]] and an elected member of [[Guha Research Conference]]. The [[Department of Biotechnology]] of the Government of India awarded him the [[National Bioscience Award for Career Development]], one of the highest Indian science awards, for his contributions to biosciences in 2009.

== Biography ==
Born in 1965 in the Indian state of [[Maharashtra]], Mohan Wani graduated in veterinary science from [[Nagpur Veterinary College]] and earned his master's degree from [[Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Krishi Vidyapeeth]] (PDKV).<ref name="Mohan R. Wani  Scientist 'F'">{{Cite web |url=http://nccs.res.in/mrw.html |title=Mohan R. Wani Scientist 'F' |date=20 January 2018 |website=nccs.res.in |access-date=20 January 2018}}</ref> His doctoral studies were at the [[University of London]] on a [[Commonwealth Fellowship]] and after securing a PhD, he returned to India to join the [[National Centre for Cell Science]] (NCCS) of [[Savitribai Phule Pune University]]. At NCCS, he held the position of a Grade F scientist at the Venture Center Outreach Center<ref name="Dr. Mohan Wani - Venture Center Outreach Center">{{Cite web |url=http://www.venturecenter.co.in/nccs/capabilities/tag/dr-mohan-wani |title=Dr. Mohan Wani - Venture Center Outreach Center |website=www.venturecenter.co.in |language=en-US |access-date=20 January 2018}}</ref> and was a part of the research groups on ''Cell Organization and Function'', ''Pathogenesis and Cellular Response'' as well as ''Stem Cells and Regeneration''.<ref name="Research Groups">{{Cite web |url=http://nccs.res.in/ResearchGroups.html |title=Research Groups |date=20 January 2018 |website=nccs.res.in |access-date=20 January 2018}}</ref> He resided at the University Campus in Ganeshkkind, [[Pune]] in Maharashtra.<ref name="NASI fellows">{{Cite web |url=http://www.nasi.org.in/fellows.asp?RsFilter=W |title=NASI fellows |date=12 January 2018 |publisher=National Academy of Sciences, India |access-date=12 January 2018}}</ref>

Wani's research focus was in the fields of bone and cartilage cell biology, [[osteoimmunology]], [[arthritis]], [[stem cell science]] and [[regenerative medicine]].<ref name="Mohan R. Wani  Scientist 'F'" /> He was known to have worked extensively on ''recombinant mouse [[Interleukin 3|IL-3]]'' and developed mouse models of [[rheumatoid arthritis]] in humans. His studies have been documented by way of a number of articles{{Refn|group=note|Please see ''Selected bibliography'' section}} and [[ResearchGate]], an online repository of scientific articles has listed 50 of them.<ref name="On ResearchGate">{{Cite web |url=https://www.researchgate.net/scientific-contributions/38944627_Mohan_R_Wani |title=On ResearchGate |date=9 January 2018 |access-date=9 January 2018}}</ref> He was a member of the ''Task Force on Stem Cell Research and Regenerative Medicine'' of the [[Department of Biotechnology]] of the Government of India<ref name="Task Force on Stem Cell Research and Regenerative Medicine">{{Cite web |url=http://dbtindia.nic.in/wp-content/uploads/O.M-for-the-Task-Force.pdf |title=Task Force on Stem Cell Research and Regenerative Medicine |date=2014 |website=Department of Biotechnology |access-date=20 January 2018}}</ref> and delivered guest lectures on the subject.<ref name="Guest Lectures Arranged for the Students">{{Cite web |url=http://cms.sinhgad.edu/sinhgad_engineering_institutes/vadgaon_scoe/departments/bio_technology/industry_interaction/guest_lectures.aspx |title=Guest Lectures Arranged for the Students |date=20 January 2018 |website=cms.sinhgad.edu |access-date=20 January 2018}}</ref> He also served as a member of the editorial board of the ''Journal of Animal Science'' of the Laboratory Animal Scientists' Association (India).<ref name="Journal of Animal Science">{{Cite web |url=http://www.lasaindia.in/journal/editorialboard.php |title=Journal of Animal Science |date=20 January 2018 |website=www.lasaindia.in |access-date=20 January 2018}}</ref> Wani died on 14 April 2024, at the age of 59.<ref>[https://indianexpress.com/article/cities/pune/scientists-death-dr-mohan-wani-director-national-centre-cell-science-9269586/ Scientists mourn death of Dr Mohan Wani, director of National Centre for Cell Science]</ref>

== Awards and honors ==
Wani received the B. M. Birla Science Prize of the B. M. Birla Science Centre in 2004<ref name="B. M. Birla Science Prize">{{Cite web |url=http://www.birlasciencecentre.org/awards/birlaSciencePrizes/ |title=B. M. Birla Science Prize |date=20 January 2018 |website=www.birlasciencecentre.org |access-date=20 January 2018 |archive-date=28 January 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180128175901/http://www.birlasciencecentre.org/awards/birlaSciencePrizes/ |url-status=dead }}</ref> and the Prof B. K. Bachhawat International Travel Grant for Young Scientists of the [[Christian Medical College & Hospital|Christian Medical College]] in 2006.<ref name="Mohan R. Wani  Scientist 'F'" /> The [[Department of Biotechnology]] (DBT) of the Government of India awarded him the [[National Bioscience Award for Career Development]], one of the highest Indian science awards in 2009.<ref name="Awardees of National Bioscience Awards for Career Development">{{Cite web |url=http://dbtindia.nic.in/wp-content/uploads/2014/03/list_of_bioscience_awardees.pdf |title=Awardees of National Bioscience Awards for Career Development |date=2016 |publisher=Department of Biotechnology |access-date=20 November 2017 |archive-date=4 March 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180304191331/http://dbtindia.nic.in/wp-content/uploads/2014/03/list_of_bioscience_awardees.pdf |url-status=dead }}</ref> He became an elected fellow of the [[National Academy of Sciences, India]] in 2011.<ref name="NASI Year Book 2015">{{Cite web |url=http://www.nasi.org.in/Year%20Book%202015.pdf |title=NASI Year Book 2015 |date=12 January 2018 |publisher=National Academy of Sciences, India |access-date=12 January 2018 |archive-date=6 August 2015 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150806211716/http://www.nasi.org.in/Year%20Book%202015.pdf |url-status=dead }}</ref> He was also an elected member of [[Guha Research Conference]].<ref name="Mohan R. Wani  Scientist 'F'" />
